# Resource kinds

Scope `project` kinds live in environment `_`; scope `env` kinds live in a named environment.

## `policy` (project)

A set of allow/deny statements.

Verbs: `create`, `read`, `update`, `delete`, `list`

| field | type | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `description` | string | `""` |  |
| `statements` | list[Statement] | **required** |  |

### `Statement` (used by `policy`)

| field | type | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `effect` | "allow" \| "deny" | **required** |  |
| `actions` | list[string] | **required** | Action patterns, e.g. 'service:deploy' or 'kv:*'. |
| `resources` | list[string] | **required** | SRN patterns; '*' matches any run of characters. |
| `conditions` | map[string, map[string, string \| list[string] \| boolean]] | `null` | Operator -> {context key -> value(s)}. Operators: string_equals, string_not_equals, string_like, bool. |

## `binding` (project)

Verbs: `create`, `read`, `update`, `delete`, `list`

| field | type | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `principal` | string | **required** | e.g. 'user:dev', 'service-account:api', 'federated:ci-deploy'. |
| `policies` | list[string] | **required** |  |

## `trust` (project)

Lets an external OIDC identity (e.g. CI) obtain short-lived tokens for a service account.

Verbs: `create`, `read`, `update`, `delete`, `list`

| field | type | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `issuer` | string | **required** |  |
| `audience` | string | `"simcloud"` |  |
| `subject` | string | **required** | Exact subject or a pattern with '*', e.g. 'repo:shop/api:ref:refs/heads/main'. |
| `claims` | map[string, string] | `null` | Extra claims that must match exactly. |
| `service_account` | string | **required** |  |
| `max_ttl_seconds` | integer | `900` |  |

## `service` (env)

A long-running container service behind the load balancer.

Verbs: `create`, `read`, `update`, `delete`, `list`, `deploy`, `promote`, `rollback`, `set_traffic`, `logs`, `restart`

| field | type | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `source` | string | `"upload"` | Where releases come from; 'upload' means `sc deploy` archives. |
| `build` | list[string] | `null` | Run once per release in the source root, e.g. ['pip', 'install', '-r', 'requirements.txt', '-t', 'deps']. |
| `command` | list[string] | `null` | Start command for each instance; it must listen on $PORT. |
| `port` | integer | `8080` |  |
| `env` | map[string, string] | `null` |  |
| `secrets` | map[string, string] | `null` | Env var -> secret name; mounted at start, never logged. |
| `databases` | map[string, string] | `null` | Env var -> database name; a DSN with short-lived credentials, issued at start as the service account (needs database:connect). |
| `min_instances` | integer | `1` |  |
| `max_instances` | integer | `3` |  |
| `cpu_millis` | integer | `500` |  |
| `memory_mb` | integer | `512` |  |
| `readiness` | Probe | `null` |  |
| `service_account` | string \| null | `null` |  |
| `regions` | list[string] | `null` |  |
| `drain_seconds` | integer | `10` | Time a stopping instance keeps serving in-flight requests. |
| `rollout_timeout_seconds` | integer | `120` | A release that isn't ready within this time fails and is not routed to. |

### `Probe` (used by `service`)

| field | type | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | `"/healthz"` |  |
| `interval_seconds` | integer | `5` |  |
| `timeout_seconds` | integer | `2` |  |
| `failure_threshold` | integer | `3` |  |

| field | type | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `source` | string | **required** |  |
| `handler` | string | **required** |  |
| `timeout_seconds` | integer | `30` |  |
| `max_concurrency` | integer | `10` |  |
| `env` | map[string, string] | `null` |  |
| `secrets` | map[string, string] | `null` |  |
| `service_account` | string \| null | `null` |  |
| `triggers` | list[map[string, string]] | `null` | e.g. {'queue': 'orders'} or {'http': '/hook'}. |

## `cluster` (env)

A managed Kubernetes cluster. 'connect' issues kubectl credentials.

Verbs: `create`, `read`, `update`, `delete`, `list`, `connect`

| field | type | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `version` | string | `"1.34"` |  |
| `nodes` | integer | `3` | Fixed by the environment; informational. |
| `zones` | list[string] | `null` |  |
| `access` | list[AccessEntry] | `null` | Who gets which Kubernetes role. SimCloud keeps matching RoleBindings/ClusterRoleBindings (label simcloud.dev/managed) in sync. |

### `AccessEntry` (used by `cluster`)

| field | type | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `principal` | string | **required** | A SimCloud principal, e.g. 'user:dev' or 'service-account:deployer'. Its Kubernetes user name is the same string. |
| `cluster_role` | "cluster-admin" \| "admin" \| "edit" \| "view" | **required** |  |
| `namespaces` | list[string] | `null` | Namespaces the role applies in; empty means cluster-wide. |
